# SK0201 — The body style is not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would change a block body to an expression body or the reverse.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Syntax |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

Body shape is cleanup rather than whitespace: changing `{ return value; }` to `=> value` rewrites syntax even when it preserves behavior. The finding is produced from the arranger's actual fixed-point edit, so `verify` and `arrange` share one implementation and one effective configuration.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
int Value() { return 1; }
```

Write:

```csharp
int Value() => 1;
```

## When it does not fire

None relative to the effective configuration. Formatter-off regions are excluded and every proposed tree rewrite passes the arrangement safety checks before it is reported.

## Configuration

- `skala_method_or_operator_body`
- `skala_local_function_body`
- `skala_constructor_or_destructor_body`
- `skala_accessor_owner_body`
- `skala_use_heuristics_for_body_style`
